name: ToolsGroup
summary: Enterprise supply chain planning software, sold as SO99+, JustEnough and a platform the vendor calls Decion. It claims probabilistic demand forecasting with a full probability distribution for every SKU-location, multi-echelon inventory optimization against per-class service targets, and replenishment that recommends when, where and how much to reorder. No job is claimed in this entry: see the profile, which sets out element by element what the vendor's words cover and the one element of each scm planning job they do not reach.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-13, no credentials: www.toolsgroup.com serves a hand-written llms.txt (200), while docs.toolsgroup.com and support.toolsgroup.com both answer a Cloudflare managed challenge (403, cf-mitigated: challenge). No public API docs; no MCP server (mcp.toolsgroup.com has no address record).
